description: Two-agent audit-and-patch pipeline: an auditor (read-only) documents the zip-slip weakness in the archive extractor (CWE-22), then a patcher (depends_on auditor) contains extraction to the destination directory while the clean archive keeps working - proven by a gate that replays the malicious archive.

criteria: The auditor's findings name extract_archive, the ../ zip-slip path and CWE-22; the patcher's fix validates that every entry resolves inside the destination (realpath/commonpath-style containment) so the malicious archive can no longer write into canary/ while the clean archive extracts correctly - verified by replaying both archives through the gate.
